title: [BFD]Syncd crash due to race condition in notification between session down and remove
author: dgsudharsan
body:

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
Sometimes during regression it is observed that syncd crashes. This is due a race condition in BFD notification. 

```
2023-10-13.23:41:31.858215|c|SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_BFD_SESSION:oid:0x45000000000e02|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_TYPE=SAI_BFD_SESSION_TYPE_ASYNC_ACTIVE|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_LOCAL_DISCRIMINATOR=154|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_UDP_SRC_PORT=49305|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_REMOTE_DISCRIMINATOR=0|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_BFD_ENCAPSULATION_TYPE=SAI_BFD_ENCAPSULATION_TYPE_NONE|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_IPHDR_VERSION=6|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_SRC_IP_ADDRESS=2002:2000::10|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_DST_IP_ADDRESS=2002:2000::11|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_MIN_TX=1000000|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_MIN_RX=1000000|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_MULTIPLIER=10|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_TOS=192|SAI_BFD_SESSION_ATTR_VIRTUAL_ROUTER=oid:0x3000000000002
Oct 14 02:41:31.858895 r-tigon-21 NOTICE syncd#SDK: [SAI_BFD.NOTICE] ./src/mlnx_sai_bfd.c[1068]- mlnx_create_bfd_session: Create BFD_SESSION: #0 TYPE=ASYNC_ACTIVE #1 LOCAL_DISCRIMINATOR=154 #2 UDP_SRC_PORT=49305 #3 REMOTE_DISCRIMINATOR=0 #4 BFD_ENCAPSULATION_TYPE=NONE #5 IPHDR_VERSION=6 #6 SRC_IP_ADDRESS=2002:2000::10 #7 DST_IP_ADDRESS=2002:2000::11 #8 MIN_TX=1000000 #9 MIN_RX=1000000 #10 MULTIPLIER=10 #11 TOS=192 #12 VIRTUAL_ROUTER=VIRTUAL_ROUTER [OID:0x3] [sx_router_id:0] 
Oct 14 02:41:31.859344 r-tigon-21 NOTICE syncd#SDK: [SAI_BFD.NOTICE] ./src/mlnx_sai_bfd.c[1166]- mlnx_create_bfd_session: Created BFD_SESSION [OID:0x18400000045] [ID:6]

2023-10-13.23:41:55.913258|r|SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_BFD_SESSION:oid:0x45000000000e02
Oct 14 02:41:55.914720 r-tigon-21 NOTICE syncd#SDK: [SAI_BFD.NOTICE] ./src/mlnx_sai_bfd.c[1201]- mlnx_remove_bfd_session: Remove BFD_SESSION [OID:0x18400000045] [ID:6]

Oct 14 02:41:55.914720 r-tigon-21 NOTICE syncd#SDK: [SAI_SWITCH.NOTICE] ./src/mlnx_sai_switch.c[5094]- mlnx_switch_bfd_event_handle: BFD peer [2002:2000::11] is Down

Oct 14 02:41:55.916443 r-tigon-21 ERR syncd#SDK: :- allocateNewObjectId: object type of switch oid:0x0 is SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_NULL, should be SWITCH
Oct 14 02:41:55.918436 r-tigon-21 INFO syncd#supervisord: syncd terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
Oct 14 02:41:55.918436 r-tigon-21 INFO syncd#supervisord: syncd   what():  :- allocateNewObjectId: object type of switch oid:0x0 is SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_NULL, should be SWITCH

```
There is a race condition b/w BFD session delete and session state down notifcation coming from ASIC. syncd recieves state down notification after processing the session delete which cause it to throw because translateRidToViD fails Ref: [https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-sairedis/blob/5887d31ad7c8b63e19390a876270028606d2e4fe/syncd/NotificationProcessor.cpp#L522](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-sairedis/blob/5887d31ad7c8b63e19390a876270028606d2e4fe/syncd/NotificationProcessor.cpp#L522et/sonic-sairedis/blob/master/syncd/NotificationProcessor.cpp#L522)


We may require to have a fix similar to https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-sairedis/pull/727 to avoid the race condition.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run BFD tests in a loop
2.
3.

Syncd crashes due to race condition

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/16992

We will also translate removed RID in notification in case that BFD session was removed, and notification arrived for that session asynchronously
